title: Applying Intrusion Detection System (IDS) Anomaly Detection to Agentic Action Streams

original_idea.body:
# Applying Intrusion Detection System (IDS) Anomaly Detection to Agentic Action Streams

**Problem:** Network IDS anomaly detection techniques (statistical baseline + deviation scoring) have never been applied to AI agent action streams, despite conceptual similarity (both detect anomalous sequences in a stream).

**Direction:** Build a behavioral baseline for a benign agent (action sequence distributions, tool call frequency, argument patterns). Implement a threshold-based anomaly scorer inspired by network IDS (SNORT/Suricata logic). Test on episodes containing emergent offensive behaviors. Measure AUROC for detecting offensive episodes.

**Why it matters:** Network IDS is a mature field with decades of practical development. Importing its techniques to agent monitoring could immediately improve detection without requiring novel ML research.

**Relevant context:** Network IDS literature (SNORT, Suricata, Bro/Zeek); Irregular 2026 behavioral patterns; METR 2026 monitoring gaps.
